versions.content: The Crypto Stack shall support a unified cryptographic primitives naming convention, common for all suppliers Status: DRAFT Description: The Crypto Stack should provide interfaces for mapping of unified (Crypto Stack supplier independent) cryptographic primitives’ names to some supplier specific ones. Rationale: Introduction of the unified naming convention allows to enable development of portable application source code. Dependencies: – Use Case: – Supporting Material: –
